name: code-map
description: Build an interactive, layered code map of a repository as a local HTML file — architecture overview, module dependency map, algorithm pipeline with typed data flow, and the functions inside each stage. Every node deep-links to your editor and carries typed inputs/outputs, hotspot flags, search, and per-node notes. Every edge cites the source line it was seen on; unconfirmed edges are drawn dashed and labeled inferred.

defaultPrompt: Run /code-map:code-map (Claude Code) or $code-map (Codex) in the repository you want mapped; add a path or --entry <symbol> to focus it.
